The second path connects staurosporine to Transmembrane glycoprotein NMB, which is a target of flavopiridol, also leading to the Mineralocorticoid receptor. Both pathways indicate that staurosporine could influence the Mineralocorticoid receptor through different molecular mechanisms, potentially via the activation of downstream targets. The scores from the two paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain. The evidence highlights the possibility of staurosporine acting as a modulator of the Mineralocorticoid receptor through distinct but related targets, underscoring the complexity of drug-target interactions in this context.
